about:
# AdvancedSumAttempts
Show total attempts counts (and many other stats) for the levels visible on screen, including gauntlets and level lists.

This mod was written entirely using the Nano text editor.

Mod idea suggested by [joar0229](https://discord.com/users/1002209858633867385).

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.
changelog:
# AdvancedSumAttempts Changelog
## v1.0.5
- Fix another easily preventible crash.
## v1.0.4
- Added a toggle to disable/hide the button in Globed menus.
- Adjusted font size in some summary popups.
- Fix some more silly oversights with node retrivial in Globed's layers for Globed v2.0.0 betas.
## v1.0.3
- Fix positioning issues.
- Fix a silly oversight preventing press-and-hold functionality from working on Globed's layers.
## v1.0.2
- Implement "press and hold" to view sums only for completed levels.
  - Whether this will work on non-"vanilla GD" menus is unclear.
## v1.0.1
- Port to GD 2.2081.
## v1.0.0
- Initial release (on GitHub).
